description: WebBroker dealer shell: product areas and navigation paths in user-facing language. No CSS/XPath/selectors. Reconcile wording on https://ctqa.prosp.devexperts.com/webbroker/ in Stage 3.

areas.label: Orders, order book, and desk order tools

feature_paths.primary_path: Launch WebBroker URL (e.g. /webbroker/) → sign-in / login form → submit credentials → authenticated dealer shell loads
feature_paths.shell_note: Pre-auth; labels may read Sign in, Log in, or SSO. Not the retail-only root trading URL.

feature_paths.primary_path: Authenticated WebBroker shell → application header → firm / client account or portfolio selector (dropdown or control)
alt_paths: Switch account from Order Entry or another widget that prompts for header selection
blocked_unless: At least one visible account or portfolio for the dealer user

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker main workspace → Watchlist widget or panel (list/grid view)
alt_paths: Add Watchlist from workspace widget gallery or desk layout manager if not already on layout

feature_paths.primary_path: Dealer workspace → Chart (Advanced Charts / TradingView) widget → select or link instrument for the active account context
alt_paths: Open chart from Instrument page or watchlist context in WebBroker

feature_paths.primary_path: Dealer workspace → Market Depth (Level 2) widget → active symbol tied to desk selection or watchlist
alt_paths: Open depth from Instrument or quote context if offered in WebBroker
blocked_unless: Entitled depth for symbol where applicable

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace → Order Entry (order ticket) widget or dock → confirm firm/client trading account in header when prompted
alt_paths: Launch Order Entry from chart, instrument, or Watchlist context within WebBroker
blocked_unless: Trading account selected when product requires it
feature_paths.shell_note: Dealer layout may pin OE differently from retail Cornèrtrader root shell; validate on /webbroker/.

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace → Orders widget (card or list) → expand or open full orders view for the selected desk context
alt_paths: Instrument page → Portfolio tab → Orders section when exposed for the symbol

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker dealer workspace → Order Book widget (internal / working orders across statuses)
alt_paths: Alternate desk layouts may surface Order Book from a different workspace tab or palette
blocked_unless: Dealer or back-office role with Order Book entitlement
feature_paths.shell_note: Primary dealer surface; retail-only client shells typically omit this path.

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace → Position Book (Positions) widget or grid for the active account
alt_paths: Instrument page → Portfolio tab → Positions when available

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace → Account list / Portfolio metrics widget (balances and metrics follow header portfolio or account selection)
blocked_unless: Header context selection when multiple firm or client accounts apply

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker header or desk menu (e.g. System Actions) → Order Defaults (default order parameters)
alt_paths: Settings or profile sidebar → Trading / Orders → Order Defaults if relabeled
feature_paths.shell_note: Retail Cornèrtrader used a compact System Actions flyout; dealer WebBroker may label similarly—Stage 3 confirms.

feature_paths.primary_path: Desk settings or profile area → Market data subscriptions (entitlements / packages)
alt_paths: Dedicated Market Data entry from WebBroker main menu if surfaced separately

feature_paths.primary_path: Global WebBroker surface: transient notifications for platform events (typically upper overlay after events)
feature_paths.shell_note: No dedicated menu; passive overlay. Desk policy copy may reference instant execution or risk.

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace or header → Messages widget or bell (chronological feed with date groupings)
alt_paths: Widget switcher menu → Messages if the layout uses shared dxTrade-class chrome

feature_paths.primary_path: Search symbol in WebBroker or open from Watchlist → Instrument (details) page → tabs (e.g. Portfolio, Stats) per deployment
WebBroker header or account/deck toolbar → Flatten all / Close all positions (confirm destructive prompt when role allows)
blocked_unless: Account with open risk or working orders
User role allows flatten on dealer shell
feature_paths.shell_note: Do not confirm destructive flows during harness mapping; locate control only in Stage 3.

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker workspace → Account Transactions widget (activity / transactions table) for the selected account
alt_paths: Widget switcher → Account Transactions if exposed like retail dxTrade5-class chrome

feature_paths.primary_path: WebBroker shell → dealer workspace layout → dxTrade-class embedded regions (Order Entry, Orders, Chart, etc.) composed per desk template
feature_paths.shell_note: Layout is deployment-specific; use sibling concept feature IDs for each concrete widget.

feature_paths.primary_path: External: Confluence CT → Cornertrader Requirements (page 342171997) → child specification pages (including WebBroker widgets)
External: Confluence DR → dxBro Requirements (page 254224494) → descendant WEB/mobile specs relevant to WebBroker
